files.name: main.py
files.code:
from sklearn.datasets import load_wine
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

X, y = load_wine(return_X_y=True)
Xtr, Xte, ytr, yte = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.3, random_state=0, stratify=y)

raw = KNeighborsClassifier(5).fit(Xtr, ytr).score(Xte, yte)
sc = StandardScaler().fit(Xtr)
scaled = KNeighborsClassifier(5).fit(sc.transform(Xtr), ytr).score(sc.transform(Xte), yte)
print("không chuẩn hoá:", round(raw, 3), "| chuẩn hoá:", round(scaled, 3))

solution.name: main.py
solution.code:
from sklearn.datasets import load_wine
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

X, y = load_wine(return_X_y=True)
Xtr, Xte, ytr, yte = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.3, random_state=0, stratify=y)
acc_raw = KNeighborsClassifier(5).fit(Xtr, ytr).score(Xte, yte)
sc = StandardScaler().fit(Xtr)
acc_scaled = KNeighborsClassifier(5).fit(sc.transform(Xtr), ytr).score(sc.transform(Xte), yte)
print(round(acc_raw, 3), round(acc_scaled, 3))

solution.name: main.py
solution.code:
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import CountVectorizer
from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB

texts = ["win free money now", "free prize claim now", "cheap pills free offer",
         "meeting at noon tomorrow", "project report due friday", "lunch with the team today"]
labels = ["spam", "spam", "spam", "ham", "ham", "ham"]
new_msgs = ["free money prize", "team meeting tomorrow"]
vec = CountVectorizer()
nb = MultinomialNB().fit(vec.fit_transform(texts), labels)
pred = list(nb.predict(vec.transform(new_msgs)))
print(pred)
